title: The Swing Issue That Could Win a Swing State

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross Sorkin.

sentences.zh: 我为《纽约时报》的每日通讯《Dealbook》报道商业和政策新闻。

sentences.en: Tell me about your experience going around the country right now.
sentences.zh: 跟我说说你现在在全国各地走访的经历吧。

sentences.en: Yeah, so I've been basically traveling around the country, and, like, everybody I talk to, you ask them who they support for president, they give you some kind of an answer.
sentences.zh: 好的，我基本上一直在全国各地奔波，我交谈过的每个人，当你问他们支持谁当总统时，他们都会给你某种回答。

sentences.en: And then what they really are asking, though, and what they really seem to want to know is, well, who can win?
sentences.zh: 但他们真正想问的，或者说他们真正想知道的是，嗯，谁能赢？

sentences.en: Like, who's the best candidate to win?
sentences.zh: 比如，谁是胜算最大的候选人？

sentences.en: They don't want to just know who they like.
sentences.zh: 他们不想只知道自己喜欢谁。

sentences.en: They want to know who some magical person they don't know in a swing state likes.
sentences.zh: 他们想知道摇摆州里那些他们不认识的“神奇人物”喜欢谁。

sentences.en: This is the electability conversation.
sentences.zh: 这就是关于“胜算”的讨论。

sentences.en: This is the electability conversation.
sentences.zh: 这就是关于“胜算”的讨论。

sentences.en: Everybody seems to want, more than anything, to beat Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 每个人似乎最想做的事就是击败唐纳德·特朗普。

sentences.en: And a lot of people, they care about what they care about, but they also seem to care what other people who they don't know who live thousands or a hundred miles away care about.
sentences.zh: 很多人关心他们自己关心的议题，但他们似乎也关心那些远在千里之外、他们根本不认识的人在关心什么。

sentences.en: Right, like, if you like Bernie Sanders, it's like, is he too old?
sentences.zh: 没错，比如如果你喜欢伯尼·桑德斯，人们就会问，他是不是太老了？

sentences.en: If you like Elizabeth Warren, it's like, well, can a woman win after what happened with Hillary Clinton?
sentences.zh: 如果你喜欢伊丽莎白·沃伦，人们就会问，希拉里·克林顿那次之后，女性还能赢吗？

sentences.en: If you like Pete Buttigieg, you're like, well, he's gay.
sentences.zh: 如果你喜欢皮特·布蒂吉格，人们就会说，嗯，他是同性恋。

sentences.en: Or Medicare for all, it's like, well, is that going too far?
sentences.zh: 或者谈到“全民医保”，人们就会说，嗯，这会不会走得太远了？

sentences.en: Or is that going to bring out a bunch of young people?
sentences.zh: 或者这会不会吸引一大批年轻人？

sentences.en: Like, everyone's just kind of, like, gaming who can win, essentially.
sentences.zh: 每个人基本上都在盘算谁能赢。

sentences.en: Yes, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 是的，绝对是这样。

sentences.en: It's like, it's issues and it's identity and it's all wrapped up in a giant set of insecurities that the entire Democratic Party has that they're going to lose again.
sentences.zh: 这关乎议题，关乎身份，所有这些都包裹在整个民主党对“再次失败”的巨大不安全感之中。

sentences.en: And they don't know why.
sentences.zh: 而且他们不知道原因。

sentences.en: And they somehow want to answer that question in advance.
sentences.zh: 他们不知何故想提前回答那个问题。

sentences.zh: 好吧，你能先介绍一下你自己吗？

sentences.zh: 你能先做个自我介绍吗？

sentences.en: And then, yeah, we'll get into where we're going.
sentences.zh: 然后，好的，我们再进入正题。

sentences.zh: 我是谢恩·戈德马赫。

sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的政治记者。

sentences.en: And we are just crossing over a river, driving to Braddock, Pennsylvania.
sentences.zh: 我们现在正穿过一条河，开车前往宾夕法尼亚州的布拉多克。

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》节目。

sentences.en: Today, the electability question that's consuming the Democratic Party is difficult to report on because it often feels so abstract.
sentences.zh: 今天，困扰民主党的“胜算”问题很难报道，因为它往往感觉太抽象了。

sentences.en: But if electability is a question of who can gather the votes needed to beat Donald Trump in the general election,
sentences.zh: 但如果“胜算”是一个关于谁能获得在大选中击败唐纳德·特朗普所需选票的问题，

sentences.en: then there are three Rust Belt swing states that are critical to winning this year, Wisconsin, Michigan, and Pennsylvania.
sentences.zh: 那么有三个铁锈地带的摇摆州对今年的胜负至关重要：威斯康星州、密歇根州和宾夕法尼亚州。

sentences.en: And in Pennsylvania, there is one issue that could be decisive, fracking natural gas.
sentences.zh: 而在宾夕法尼亚州，有一个问题可能是决定性的：天然气水力压裂法。

sentences.en: So opposition to fracking could be fatal for a candidate there.
sentences.zh: 因此，反对水力压裂对那里的候选人来说可能是致命的。

sentences.en: And yet, today, Senator Elizabeth Warren said in a tweet that she would ban fracking everywhere in an executive order.
sentences.zh: 然而，今天，伊丽莎白·沃伦参议员在推特上表示，她将通过行政命令在全国范围内禁止水力压裂。

sentences.en: We need to put an end to fracking all over this country.
sentences.zh: 我们需要在全国范围内终结水力压裂。

sentences.en: Two leading Democratic candidates have said that if elected, they will ban fracking everywhere.
sentences.zh: 两位领先的民主党候选人已经表示，如果当选，他们将在全国范围内禁止水力压裂。

sentences.en: My colleagues, Shane Goldmacher, Andy Mills, and Monica Efstatieva, traveled to western Pennsylvania to see if electability is as simple as who supports fracking in Pennsylvania.
sentences.zh: 我的同事谢恩·戈德马赫、安迪·米尔斯和莫妮卡·埃夫斯塔蒂耶娃前往宾夕法尼亚州西部，看看“胜算”是否真的就像谁支持宾州的水力压裂那么简单。

sentences.en: It's Friday, January 24th.
sentences.zh: 今天是1月24日，星期五。

sentences.en: We're in right of Pennsylvania, driving to the home of the lieutenant governor of Pennsylvania, John Fetterman,
sentences.zh: 我们正在宾夕法尼亚州，开车前往宾夕法尼亚州副州长约翰·费特曼的家，

sentences.en: who I think in a lot of ways embodies this question that Democrats are struggling with over who to support and who can win.
sentences.zh: 我认为他在很多方面体现了民主党人在支持谁和谁能赢的问题上所挣扎的困境。

sentences.en: We've arrived.
sentences.zh: 我们到了。

sentences.en: So we arrive at John Fetterman's house.
sentences.zh: 我们到达了约翰·费特曼的家。

sentences.en: We have a lot of power lines and smoke, steam, and a steel plant with high voltage signs.
sentences.zh: 这里有很多电线、烟雾、蒸汽，还有一家挂着高压标志的钢铁厂。

sentences.en: It's across the street from a steel mill.
sentences.zh: 它就在一家钢铁厂的街对面。

sentences.en: No trespassing security patrol.
sentences.zh: “禁止擅入，保安巡逻”。

sentences.en: It's exactly what you would imagine a western Pennsylvania landscape to look like.
sentences.zh: 这正是你想象中宾夕法尼亚州西部的景观。

sentences.en: Let's go meet him.
sentences.zh: 我们去见他吧。

sentences.en: And John Fetterman comes out to say hello.
sentences.zh: 约翰·费特曼出来迎接我们。

sentences.en: How are you?
sentences.zh: 你好吗？

sentences.en: Good.
sentences.zh: 很好。

sentences.en: How are you?
sentences.zh: 你呢？

sentences.en: Excellent.
sentences.zh: 非常好。

sentences.en: Fetterman doesn't look like your typical politician.
sentences.zh: 费特曼看起来不像典型的政客。

sentences.en: You own the building.
sentences.zh: 这栋楼是你的？

sentences.en: Six foot eight.
sentences.zh: 他身高六英尺八英寸（约2.03米）。

sentences.en: He's a bald guy, goatee, tattoos on his arMs.
sentences.zh: 他是个光头，留着山羊胡，手臂上有纹身。

sentences.en: Is this all your place?
sentences.zh: 这整个地方都是你的吗？

sentences.en: We shake hands.
sentences.zh: 我们握了握手。

sentences.en: We go into his apartment.
sentences.zh: 我们走进他的公寓。

sentences.en: This is so cool.
sentences.zh: 这太酷了。

sentences.en: The second floor of an old industrial-type building.
sentences.zh: 这是一栋老式工业建筑的二楼。

sentences.en: Christmas decorations up because it's December.
sentences.zh: 因为是十二月，还挂着圣诞装饰。

sentences.en: Well, tell us where you want us to sit down.
sentences.zh: 告诉我们你想让我们坐在哪里。

sentences.en: And he escorts us to a couple of couches in the middle of the room.
sentences.zh: 他把我们带到房间中间的几张沙发旁。

sentences.en: And we begin talking.
sentences.zh: 我们开始交谈。

sentences.en: My name's John Fetterman.
sentences.zh: 我叫约翰·费特曼。

sentences.en: I'm the lieutenant governor of Pennsylvania.
sentences.zh: 我是宾夕法尼亚州副州长。

sentences.en: And we are sitting in my home, which sits directly across the street from the Edgar Thompson steel mill here in Braddock, Pennsylvania.
sentences.zh: 我们现在坐在我的家里，它就位于宾夕法尼亚州布拉多克的埃德加·汤普森钢铁厂街对面。

sentences.en: His story is interesting.
sentences.zh: 他的故事很有趣。

sentences.en: He may not look like a typical politician, but he has some of the typical politician pedigree.
sentences.zh: 他看起来可能不像典型的政客，但他确实拥有一些典型的政客背景。

sentences.en: He went to Harvard for public policy school.
sentences.zh: 他曾就读于哈佛大学公共政策学院。

sentences.en: I came to Braddock out of graduate school because I wanted to take an opportunity to confront in my own way the raging inequality that I had witnessed and seen in this country.
sentences.zh: 我研究生毕业后来到布拉多克，是因为我想抓住机会，以我自己的方式去面对我在这个国家所目睹的猖獗的不平等。

sentences.en: And what he finds when he moves to Braddock in 2001 is this suffering and struggling post-industrial western Pennsylvania town that 100 years ago had 20,000 people and now has a little over 2,000 people.
sentences.zh: 2001年他搬到布拉多克时，发现这是一个饱受苦难和挣扎的后工业化宾州西部小镇，100年前有2万人，现在只有2000多人。

sentences.en: Abandonment, 90 percent of the population was gone.
sentences.zh: 荒废，90%的人口已经流失。

sentences.en: Huge disparity in what you see here versus what you would see 15 minutes away and around Pittsburgh.
sentences.zh: 这里和你15分钟车程外的匹兹堡周边地区相比，存在巨大的差距。

sentences.en: And four years after moving there, he ran for mayor.
sentences.zh: 搬到那里四年后，他竞选了市长。

sentences.en: I won the primary and took office.
sentences.zh: 我赢得了初选并就职了。

sentences.en: And I feel like you skipped a part of how close your election was.
sentences.zh: 我觉得你跳过了一部分，没说你的选举有多惊险。

sentences.en: Well, if you already know, quite frankly, I mean, this is well-worn.
sentences.zh: 好吧，如果你已经知道了，坦白说，这已经是老生常谈了。

sentences.en: He wins by one vote.
sentences.zh: 他以一票之差获胜。

sentences.en: And as mayor, he sort of really began to embody this little town.
sentences.zh: 作为市长，他开始真正融入这个小镇。

sentences.en: He had the zip code tattooed on one of his forearMs.
sentences.zh: 他把邮政编码纹在了一只前臂上。

sentences.en: And on his other forearm, he would tattoo the date of every homicide that happened under his watch as mayor.
sentences.zh: 而在另一只前臂上，他会纹上他担任市长期间发生的每一桩凶杀案的日期。

sentences.en: And he became sort of seen as like a symbol of Braddock, this sort of rough western Pennsylvania town.
sentences.zh: 他被视为布拉多克这个宾州西部粗犷小镇的象征。

sentences.en: The things that brought me to Braddock are the things that informed me on what I've wanted to accomplish statewide.
sentences.zh: 把我带到布拉多克的东西，也塑造了我想要在全州范围内实现的目标。

sentences.en: Eventually, he has higher ambition for statewide office.
sentences.zh: 最终，他有了竞选全州公职的更高抱负。

sentences.en: He runs for Senate in 2016 and badly loses the Democratic primary.
sentences.zh: 他在2016年竞选参议员，但在民主党初选中惨败。

sentences.en: He runs for lieutenant governor in 2018.
sentences.zh: 他在2018年竞选副州长。

sentences.en: And this time he wins, running from the left.
sentences.zh: 这一次他赢了，以左翼立场参选。

sentences.en: When you line up your sort of viewpoints, you fall pretty far on the progressive spectrum, right?
sentences.zh: 当你列出你的观点时，你属于进步派光谱中相当靠左的位置，对吧？

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: I fall on what I think is the fair spectrum on issues.
sentences.zh: 我认为我在议题上处于我认为公平的光谱上。

sentences.en: Well, Bernie Sanders endorsed you last year, came out and campaigned for you, right?
sentences.zh: 好吧，伯尼·桑德斯去年支持了你，还出来为你竞选，对吧？

sentences.en: That's like a...
sentences.zh: 那是……

sentences.en: In 2018, he did.
sentences.zh: 2018年他确实支持过。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Not in 2016.
Uh, and, and, uh, so...
sentences.zh: 呃，而且，呃，所以……

sentences.en: So, John Fetterman may not like labels, but...
sentences.zh: 所以，约翰·费特曼可能不喜欢标签，但是……

sentences.en: I've been unapologetically forceful in my views on criminal justice, inequality, living wage, women's reproductive freedom, marijuana legalization, immigration.
sentences.zh: 我在刑事司法、不平等、生活工资、女性生育自由、大麻合法化、移民等问题上的观点一直是不加掩饰且强硬的。

sentences.en: My wife was an undocumented dreamer.
sentences.zh: 我的妻子曾是一名无证的“追梦人”。

sentences.en: I performed the first same-sex wedding in Pennsylvania when it was still illegal in Pennsylvania, in this very building.
sentences.zh: 我在宾夕法尼亚州同性婚姻尚属非法时，就在这栋楼里主持了第一场同性婚礼。

sentences.en: He aligns closely with the left of the Democratic Party, with one big notable exception.
sentences.zh: 他在很大程度上与民主党左翼保持一致，但有一个显著的例外。

sentences.en: Men and women need to eat and put a roof over their head, and I am willing to die on the union way of life hill this time...
sentences.zh: 人们需要吃饭，需要有栖身之所，这一次我愿意为工会的生活方式而战……

sentences.en: Fracking.
sentences.zh: 水力压裂。

sentences.en: In Western Pennsylvania, the union way of life, especially in the last decade, is so dependent on fracking, the extraction of natural gas from deep in the ground.
sentences.zh: 在宾夕法尼亚州西部，工会的生活方式，特别是在过去十年里，非常依赖水力压裂，即从地下深处开采天然气。

sentences.en: There needs to be the most stringent, rigorous environmental controls and oversights, and plans to continually transition towards cleaner energy sources,
sentences.zh: 需要有最严格、最严谨的环境控制和监督，以及持续向更清洁能源转型的计划，

sentences.en: but it's still a necessary part of our economy.
sentences.zh: 但它仍然是我们经济中必要的一部分。

sentences.en: And so, while John Fetterman would not describe himself, and he would probably resist the label of being a pro-energy, pro-industry Democrat, he wants to fight for those jobs,
sentences.zh: 所以，虽然约翰·费特曼不会这样描述自己，而且他可能会抵触“亲能源、亲产业的民主党人”这个标签，但他想为那些工作岗位而战，

sentences.en: and that puts him at odds with the left of the Democratic Party.
sentences.zh: 这使他与民主党左翼产生了分歧。

sentences.en: You know, vote your job, lobby your hobby, you know?
sentences.zh: 你知道，“为你的工作投票，为你的爱好游说”，懂吗？

sentences.en: And it's, it's like...
sentences.zh: 而且，这就像……

sentences.en: Explain that.
sentences.zh: 解释一下。

sentences.en: What do you mean by vote your job?
sentences.zh: 你说的“为你的工作投票”是什么意思？

sentences.en: Vote your job.
sentences.zh: 为你的工作投票。

sentences.en: It's like, okay, what if you are particularly keen on gun rights or any of these other issues?
sentences.zh: 就像是，好吧，如果你特别热衷于枪支权利或其他任何议题，

sentences.en: You can lobby and be about that, but at the end of the day, don't you want to take a vacation and be paid for it?
sentences.zh: 你可以去游说，去关注那些，但归根结底，难道你不想去度假并为此获得报酬吗？

sentences.en: Don't you want to have enough money to send your kids to school?
sentences.zh: 难道你不想有足够的钱送你的孩子上学吗？

sentences.en: If you destroy unions, I don't have a job, or I don't have a job that can keep a roof over my head or pay my bills.
sentences.zh: 如果你摧毁了工会，我就没有工作，或者我就没有一份能让我有栖身之所或支付账单的工作。

sentences.en: And here's where Fetterman is concerned about what he's seeing in the presidential contest, especially from the progressive candidates he's otherwise so closely aligned with.
sentences.zh: 这就是费特曼对他在总统竞选中所看到的情况感到担忧的地方，尤其是来自那些他原本立场非常一致的进步派候选人的竞选。

sentences.en: Where are you when you look at this 2020 field?
sentences.zh: 当你审视2020年的这些候选人时，你是怎么看的？

sentences.en: You haven't endorsed yet, right?
sentences.zh: 你还没表态支持谁，对吧？

sentences.en: No, I haven't.
sentences.zh: 不，我还没有。

sentences.en: And what I'm at right now is that I am alarmed that there could be a false sense of complacency within our party.
sentences.zh: 我现在感到担忧的是，我们党内可能存在一种虚假的自满情绪。

sentences.en: He's touching on one of the real concerns that Democrats have, that the economy is doing better, and Donald Trump can get re-elected because of it.
sentences.zh: 他触及了民主党人真正担忧的问题之一：经济正在好转，唐纳德·特朗普可能会因此连任。

sentences.en: And at the same time, you have some Democrats talking about ending entire industries like fracking, that is a key source of good, high-paying jobs in his corner of his state,
sentences.zh: 与此同时，一些民主党人谈论要终结像水力压裂这样的整个行业，而这正是他所在州这一地区优质、高薪工作的重要来源，

sentences.en: which happens to be one of the most important states in the country.
sentences.zh: 而这恰好是全国最重要的州之一。

sentences.en: I'm the only candidate which has a policy about how to bring economic opportunity using clean, renewable energy as the key into coal country.
sentences.zh: 我是唯一一位有政策主张的候选人，该政策旨在利用清洁、可再生能源作为关键，为煤炭产区带来经济机会。

sentences.en: He talked to John Fetterman, and he's haunted by the 2016 election, and in particular, a stray remark by Hillary Clinton.
sentences.zh: 他与约翰·费特曼交谈过，他被2016年的选举所困扰，特别是希拉里·克林顿的一句无心之言。

sentences.en: One of the things that damaged her specifically was this quote.
sentences.zh: 特别损害她形象的事情之一就是这句话。

sentences.en: We're going to put a lot of coal miners and coal companies out of business, right, Tim?
sentences.zh: 我们要让很多煤矿工人和煤炭公司倒闭，对吧，蒂姆？

sentences.en: To the effect that she can't wait to put coal miners, you know, out of business.
sentences.zh: 大意是她迫不及待地想让煤矿工人失业。

sentences.en: And coal miners is a profession that is easily transferable to steel or other industry jobs, you know.
sentences.zh: 而煤矿工人这个职业是很容易转行到钢铁或其他工业岗位的，你知道的。

sentences.en: She lost Pennsylvania by 44,000 votes, and he doesn't want that to happen again.
sentences.zh: 她在宾夕法尼亚州以4.4万票之差落败，他不希望这种情况再次发生。

sentences.en: Is there a parallel with fracking now?
sentences.zh: 现在水力压裂问题有类似之处吗？

sentences.en: Well, I worry that there could be a parallel.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我担心可能会有类似之处。

sentences.en: As I've said on the record, that Pennsylvania is a margin play, and an outright ban on fracking isn't a margin play.
sentences.zh: 正如我公开说过的，宾夕法尼亚州是胜负边缘的博弈，而彻底禁止水力压裂并不是一种边缘博弈。

sentences.en: That's provocative.
sentences.zh: 那太具挑衅性了。

sentences.en: He sees Pennsylvania as so close that almost anything can make the difference.
sentences.zh: 他认为宾夕法尼亚州的选情如此胶着，几乎任何事情都可能成为胜负的关键。

sentences.en: And, in fact, President Trump has already made clear that he wants to campaign in Pennsylvania on fracking.
sentences.zh: 事实上，特朗普总统已经明确表示，他想在宾夕法尼亚州以水力压裂为议题进行竞选。

sentences.en: Well, thank you to Vice President Pence.
sentences.zh: 嗯，感谢彭斯副总统。

sentences.en: Thank you, Mike.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，迈克。

sentences.en: And hello, Pennsylvania.
sentences.zh: 大家好，宾夕法尼亚州。

sentences.en: Hello.
sentences.zh: 大家好。

sentences.en: Last evening, the president had a rally in Hershey.
sentences.zh: 昨晚，总统在赫尔希举行了集会。

sentences.en: Hershey chocolate.
sentences.zh: 赫尔希巧克力。

sentences.en: I like Hershey chocolate.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢赫尔希巧克力。

sentences.en: And of all the places that Mr. Trump could have picked on all, you know, days when the articles of impeachment were rolled out, he went to Pennsylvania.
sentences.zh: 在弹劾条款出炉的所有日子里，特朗普先生偏偏选了宾夕法尼亚州。

sentences.en: And in the state of Pennsylvania, natural gas production is up 34% since our election.
sentences.zh: 自我们上次选举以来，宾夕法尼亚州的天然气产量增长了34%。

sentences.en: Last night demonstrated that we underestimate him at our party's peril in 2020.
sentences.zh: 昨晚的事实证明，在2020年大选中，如果我们低估他，那将是我们党的危险。

sentences.en: Virtually every leading Democrat has pledged to entirely eliminate American production of oil, clean coal, natural gas.
sentences.zh: 几乎每一位民主党领袖都承诺要彻底消除美国的石油、清洁煤和天然气生产。

sentences.en: They obviously believe it, as I have said, that whoever wins Pennsylvania wins the presidency.
sentences.zh: 正如我所说，他们显然相信，谁赢了宾夕法尼亚州，谁就赢得了总统大选。

sentences.en: Thousands and thousands of jobs.
sentences.zh: 成千上万个工作岗位。

sentences.en: Incredible.
sentences.zh: 难以置信。

sentences.en: Now, of course, John Fetterman isn't the only Pennsylvania Democrat worried about this.
sentences.zh: 当然，约翰·费特曼并不是唯一对此感到担忧的宾夕法尼亚州民主党人。

sentences.en: The mayor of Pittsburgh, local officials in fracking counties, including one county that just flipped to Republican control for the first time in decades.
sentences.zh: 还有匹兹堡市长、水力压裂作业县的当地官员，其中一个县几十年来首次转为共和党控制。

sentences.en: Besides, they're worried about this.
sentences.zh: 此外，他们也对此感到担忧。

sentences.en: And when it comes to presidential candidates, Joe Biden is taking Pennsylvania very seriously.
sentences.zh: 谈到总统候选人，乔·拜登非常认真地对待宾夕法尼亚州。

sentences.en: In fact, he's made it the center of his argument for why he's the most electable Democrat running for president.
sentences.zh: 事实上，他将其作为自己为何是参选总统中最具胜算的民主党人的核心论点。

sentences.en: He held his first campaign rally in Pittsburgh.
sentences.zh: 他在匹兹堡举行了首次竞选集会。

sentences.en: He held his campaign kickoff in Philadelphia.
sentences.zh: 他在费城举行了竞选启动仪式。

sentences.en: He claims heritage in Scranton.
sentences.zh: 他声称自己与斯克兰顿有渊源。

sentences.en: And unlike some of his rivals, Joe Biden isn't calling for a complete ban on fracking.
sentences.zh: 与他的一些竞争对手不同，乔·拜登并没有呼吁全面禁止水力压裂。

sentences.en: In fact, he said that there's no way that that's going to get done.
sentences.zh: 事实上，他说过这根本不可能实现。

sentences.en: I'm Aaron.
sentences.zh: 我是亚伦。

sentences.en: Aaron.
sentences.zh: 亚伦。

sentences.en: What I'm wondering is...
sentences.zh: 我想知道的是……

sentences.en: And when an activist came and confronted him about this in December...
sentences.zh: 当一位活动人士在十二月就此事质问他时……

sentences.en: I've looked at your climate plan.
sentences.zh: 我研究过你的气候计划。

sentences.en: Why doesn't it ban fracking?
sentences.zh: 为什么不禁止水力压裂？

sentences.en: Well, why doesn't it ban fracking?
sentences.zh: 嗯，为什么不禁止水力压裂？

sentences.en: Because you can't ban fracking right now.
sentences.zh: 因为你现在不能禁止水力压裂。

sentences.en: You've got to transition away from it.
sentences.zh: 你必须逐步过渡。

sentences.en: Look, you're going to ban fracking all across America right now, right?
sentences.zh: 听着，你现在就要在全美范围内禁止水力压裂，对吧？

sentences.en: I would love to.
sentences.zh: 我很想这样做。

sentences.en: Yeah, I'd love to, too.
sentences.zh: 是的，我也很想。

sentences.en: I'd love to make sure we don't use any oil or gas, period.
sentences.zh: 我很想确保我们不再使用任何石油或天然气，彻底不用。

sentences.en: Now.
sentences.zh: 现在。

sentences.en: Now.
sentences.zh: 现在。

sentences.en: Is it possible?
sentences.zh: 这可能吗？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: He told them...
sentences.zh: 他告诉他们……

sentences.en: Well, you ought to vote for somebody else.
sentences.zh: 嗯，那你应该投给别人。

sentences.en: ...that they shouldn't vote for him.
sentences.zh: ……他们不应该投给他。

sentences.en: He takes it that seriously.
sentences.zh: 他对此非常认真。

sentences.en: Joe Biden definitely has a distinct advantage in winning Pennsylvania.
sentences.zh: 乔·拜登在赢得宾夕法尼亚州方面确实具有明显的优势。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Simply because of his roots and where he's at and perceived and being completely neutral.
sentences.zh: 仅仅因为他的根基、他的立场以及被视为完全中立。

sentences.en: Joe Biden would be all but impossible for Trump to beat in Pennsylvania.
sentences.zh: 乔·拜登在宾夕法尼亚州几乎是特朗普无法击败的对手。

sentences.en: And Trump knows that.
sentences.zh: 特朗普也知道这一点。

sentences.en: So here's that thing again.
sentences.zh: 所以这就是那个问题。

sentences.en: He's talking about who he thinks is most electable and not who he necessarily likes beSt.
sentences.zh: 他谈论的是他认为谁最有胜算，而不是他个人最喜欢谁。

sentences.en: Do you think Bernie Sanders can beat Donald Trump in Pennsylvania?
sentences.zh: 你认为伯尼·桑德斯能在宾夕法尼亚州击败唐纳德·特朗普吗？

sentences.en: I think any one of the candidates, the mainstream candidates, can beat Donald Trump in Pennsylvania.
sentences.zh: 我认为任何一位主流候选人都能在宾夕法尼亚州击败唐纳德·特朗普。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: But it's going to be difficult for any of the candidates, if that makes sense.
sentences.zh: 但对任何候选人来说都会很困难，如果这说得通的话。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: But maybe less difficult for Joe Biden in your view.
sentences.zh: 但在你看来，对乔·拜登来说可能没那么难。

sentences.en: I would say, being completely honest, he would have an easier time than other candidates.
sentences.zh: 老实说，我会说他会比其他候选人轻松一些。

sentences.en: But I push back that every one of our candidates could do it.
sentences.zh: 但我坚持认为我们每一位候选人都能做到。

sentences.en: And so, but...
sentences.zh: 所以，但是……

sentences.en: This is why it's like a conundrum, right?
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么这像个难题，对吧？

sentences.en: Like, Democrats across the country are trying to decide whether they vote for the candidate who they most like and most line up with,
sentences.zh: 全国各地的民主党人都在试图决定，是投票给他们最喜欢、最认同的候选人，

sentences.en: or the candidate who can beat Donald Trump, or who they think can beat Donald Trump, or who they think can beat Donald Trump in a swing state.
sentences.zh: 还是投票给能击败唐纳德·特朗普的候选人，或者他们认为能击败唐纳德·特朗普的人，又或者他们认为能在摇摆州击败唐纳德·特朗普的人。

sentences.en: And nobody actually knows the answer to that question.
sentences.zh: 没有人真正知道这个问题的答案。

sentences.en: We talked about going to Claritin with the people you wanted to go meet there.
sentences.zh: 我们谈到了去克拉里顿见你想见的人。

sentences.en: Well, I think if you want to go to Claritin, I think we're left.
sentences.zh: 嗯，如果你想去克拉里顿，我想我们得走了。

sentences.en: As we wrap up, Fetterman makes pretty clear he thinks that we should be talking to other people too.
sentences.zh: 在结束时，费特曼很清楚地表明，他认为我们也应该和其他人谈谈。

sentences.en: Union members, union leaders, activists in Pennsylvania, to get a sense of how fracking and the leading Democratic candidates are playing.
sentences.zh: 宾夕法尼亚州的工会成员、工会领袖和活动人士，以了解水力压裂和民主党主要候选人的选情。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用程序？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 解锁了？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to The Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 大家都知道你需要订阅《时报》才能阅读所有报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore The Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但如果能免费试用《时报》一个月，且无需输入信用卡信息呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在可以了。

sentences.en: When you download the New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你首次下载《纽约时报》应用程序时，你在应用内的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall, to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 用一个月的时间突破付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能获得什么。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to The New York Times, download the Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，今天就下载《时报》应用程序，免费获取30天的访问权限。

sentences.en: So a group of union leaders have agreed to meet us at an Italian restaurant in Pittsburgh.
sentences.zh: 所以一群工会领袖同意在匹兹堡的一家意大利餐厅见我们。

sentences.en: We're showing up just as lunch is already wrapped, and we sit down and introduce ourselves.
sentences.zh: 我们刚到时午餐已经结束了，我们坐下来做了自我介绍。

sentences.en: Hi, Kenny Broadbent.
sentences.zh: 你好，我是肯尼·布罗德本特。

sentences.en: I'm with the Steenbitters Union.
sentences.zh: 我来自蒸汽管道工工会。

sentences.en: Jim Clinch, operating engineers.
sentences.zh: 吉姆·克林奇，操作工程师工会。

sentences.en: Hi, Rich Klaus Mechanical Contractors.
sentences.zh: 你好，我是里奇·克劳斯，机械承包商。

sentences.en: Jeff Nobers.
sentences.zh: 杰夫·诺伯斯。

sentences.en: I'm the executive director of the Builders Guild.
sentences.zh: 我是建筑协会的执行董事。

sentences.en: I'm Tom Meltzer.
sentences.zh: 我是汤姆·梅尔策。

sentences.en: I'm the head of the building trades.
sentences.zh: 我是建筑行业工会的负责人。

sentences.en: Nice to meet you.
sentences.zh: 很高兴见到你们。

sentences.en: Each of the union leaders have members that at least have some tie to the oil and gas industry in western Pennsylvania.
sentences.zh: 每位工会领袖的成员至少都与宾夕法尼亚州西部的油气行业有某种联系。

sentences.en: We're the guys that run all the heavy equipment, the cranes, the bulldozers.
sentences.zh: 我们是操作所有重型设备的人，起重机、推土机。

sentences.en: Steenbitters do heating, air conditioning, refrigeration, and process pipe work.
sentences.zh: 蒸汽管道工负责供暖、空调、制冷和工艺管道工作。

sentences.en: So a lot of pipeline work, a lot of work in the natural gas industry.
sentences.zh: 所以有很多管道工程，天然气行业也有很多工作。

sentences.en: So when it comes to natural gas, we get to work on the chirogenic plants.
sentences.zh: 谈到天然气，我们负责低温工厂的工作。

sentences.en: My International does the pipelines.
sentences.zh: 我的国际工会负责管道。

sentences.en: Collectively, these unions represent around 60,000 people.
sentences.zh: 总的来说，这些工会代表了大约6万人。

sentences.en: How big a share of your membership is Democratic?
sentences.zh: 你们的成员中有多少比例是民主党人？

sentences.en: My guess would be 90 percent of our members are registered Democrats.
sentences.zh: 我猜我们90%的成员是注册民主党人。

sentences.en: Potentially the margin for the 2020 election in Pennsylvania.
sentences.zh: 这可能是2020年宾夕法尼亚州大选的胜负关键。

sentences.en: We don't see all the evils that they talk about in fracking.
sentences.zh: 我们并没有看到他们所说的水力压裂带来的所有弊端。

sentences.en: And the first thing they want to do is tell us about just how important fracking has been in this part of the state for their members.
sentences.zh: 他们首先想告诉我们的是，水力压裂对该州这一地区的成员有多重要。

sentences.en: I'm telling you, in 2010, my local was at about 10 percent unemployment.
sentences.zh: 我告诉你，2010年，我所在的地方工会失业率约为10%。

sentences.en: Natural gas started to come here in about 2010.
sentences.zh: 天然气大约在2010年开始进入这里。

sentences.en: Within a year to a year and a half, we went from 10 percent unemployment to actually over-employment.
sentences.zh: 一年到一年半之内，我们的失业率从10%变成了实际上的人手不足。

sentences.en: I had to look for people.
sentences.zh: 我得到处找人。

sentences.en: We went to full employment.
sentences.zh: 我们实现了充分就业。

sentences.en: And we've been at or at or near full employment and occasionally over-employed since.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，我们一直处于或接近充分就业，偶尔还会人手不足。

sentences.en: There's a few things they wanted to focus on.
sentences.zh: 他们想重点谈几件事。

sentences.en: Because when people got jobs and are making middle-class ways of life...
sentences.zh: 因为当人们有了工作并过上中产阶级生活时……

sentences.en: Jobs.
sentences.zh: 工作。

sentences.en: The economy's better.
sentences.zh: 经济变好了。

sentences.en: There's less crime.
sentences.zh: 犯罪减少了。

sentences.en: There's less alcoholism.
sentences.zh: 酗酒减少了。

sentences.en: Less drug use.
sentences.zh: 吸毒减少了。

sentences.en: At the end of the day, if I don't have a job...
sentences.zh: 归根结底，如果我没有工作……

sentences.en: Jobs.
sentences.zh: 工作。

sentences.en: If I don't have health care, if I can't take care of my family, it doesn't matter if we have global peace and gun control and everything else.
sentences.zh: 如果我没有医疗保险，如果我不能照顾我的家庭，那么我们是否拥有全球和平、枪支管制或其他任何事情都无关紧要。

sentences.en: You know, how do I go to my members and say, OK, kill the industry you're working in...
sentences.zh: 你知道，我怎么能去告诉我的成员，好吧，毁掉你们正在从事的行业……

sentences.en: Jobs and jobs.
sentences.zh: 工作，还是工作。

sentences.en: The green jobs that they're talking about, that they're going to replace your job with, don't exiSt.
sentences.zh: 他们谈论的那些用来替代你们工作的绿色就业岗位，根本不存在。

sentences.en: And the few that do exist pay $10, $15 an hour with no fringe package, while my members $50 to $60 an hour total package, good wages.
sentences.zh: 而且少数存在的岗位每小时工资只有10到15美元，没有福利，而我的成员每小时总收入有50到60美元，工资待遇很好。

sentences.en: Jobs are the most important thing.
sentences.zh: 工作是最重要的事情。

sentences.en: So one of the big criticisms of fracking is that locally it creates environmental probleMs.
sentences.zh: 所以，对水力压裂的一大批评是它在当地造成了环境问题。

sentences.en: And globally, it's another generation of fossil fuel use.
sentences.zh: 在全球范围内，这是又一代化石燃料的使用。

sentences.en: At a time when scientists say, we need to stop using fossil fuels.
sentences.zh: 在科学家们说我们需要停止使用化石燃料的时候。

sentences.en: And why should we send these petrochemical plants, for instance, over to China where they won't worry about the pollution?
sentences.zh: 为什么我们要把这些石化工厂送到中国，让他们不用担心污染问题呢？

sentences.en: And they're arguing not that fracking is perfect, but that it's the best option.
sentences.zh: 他们争论的不是水力压裂是完美的，而是它是最好的选择。

sentences.en: That taking natural gas from Pennsylvania is better than taking oil or some other fossil fuel from some other part of the Middle EaSt.
sentences.zh: 从宾夕法尼亚州开采天然气，比从中东其他地区获取石油或其他化石燃料要好。

sentences.en: At least here, we're going to deal with the most modern technology and with the least amount of pollution possible.
sentences.zh: 至少在这里，我们将采用最现代化的技术，并尽可能减少污染。

sentences.en: And we're still going to keep people that have jobs here.
sentences.zh: 而且我们还能让这里的人们保住工作。

sentences.en: And when it comes to politics in Pennsylvania, these guys, union leaders, carry weight.
sentences.zh: 谈到宾夕法尼亚州的政治，这些工会领袖很有分量。

sentences.en: They advise their tens of thousands of members on what the important public policy issues are out there and how they might want to vote.
sentences.zh: 他们会建议成千上万的成员关注哪些重要的公共政策问题，以及他们可能想如何投票。

sentences.en: You know, if we end up with a Democratic candidate that supports a fracking ban, I'm going to tell my members that they either don't vote or vote for the other guy.
sentences.zh: 你知道，如果我们最终选出一位支持禁止水力压裂的民主党候选人，我会告诉我的成员，要么别投票，要么投给另一个人。

sentences.en: And I am not a fan of the president.
sentences.zh: 我并不是总统的粉丝。

sentences.en: I will be the first to tell you that.
sentences.zh: 我会第一个告诉你这一点。

sentences.en: I did not vote for the president.
sentences.zh: 我没有投票给总统。

sentences.en: I did not ask my members to vote for the president.
sentences.zh: 我没有要求我的成员投票给总统。

sentences.en: We supported Clinton in the last election.
sentences.zh: 我们在上次选举中支持了克林顿。

sentences.en: But at this point, given the nature of work, you know, I may have to do something that I'm not totally happy with.
sentences.zh: 但在这一点上，考虑到工作的性质，你知道，我可能不得不做一些我不完全满意的事情。

sentences.en: You would support Trump over a candidate?
sentences.zh: 你会支持特朗普而不是某位候选人吗？

sentences.en: I don't know that I would have a choice.
sentences.zh: 我不知道我是否还有选择。

sentences.en: I would at least be neutral.
sentences.zh: 我至少会保持中立。

sentences.en: This is a big deal in a state decided by so few votes and for a person who doesn't just represent his own vote,
sentences.zh: 在一个由极少数选票决定的州，对于一个不仅代表自己选票，

sentences.en: but is going to be advising many other people on how they should vote, too.
sentences.zh: 而且还要建议许多其他人如何投票的人来说，这可是件大事。

sentences.en: And we wanted to just before you guys all get up, we want to just ask one other question just for the audio thing.
sentences.zh: 在你们起身离开之前，我们想再问一个问题，只是为了录音。

sentences.en: And so I asked them directly.
sentences.zh: 所以我直接问了他们。

sentences.en: If Bernie Sanders or Elizabeth Warren is the nominee, how many of you guys are going to vote for Donald Trump?
sentences.zh: 如果伯尼·桑德斯或伊丽莎白·沃伦成为提名人，你们中有多少人会投票给唐纳德·特朗普？

sentences.en: I would.
sentences.zh: 我会。

sentences.en: I wouldn't vote.
sentences.zh: 我不会去投票。

sentences.en: I don't know if I would vote for him, but I won't vote.
sentences.zh: 我不知道我会不会投给他，但我不会去投票。

sentences.en: I mean, I would have to think long and hard.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我得深思熟虑一番。

sentences.en: It would be tough.
sentences.zh: 这会很难。

sentences.en: Tough for me to pull Trump's lead.
sentences.zh: 让我去支持特朗普很难。

sentences.en: And it would be for other reasons.
sentences.zh: 而且那会是出于其他原因。

sentences.en: If I was voting strictly on my membership, I would vote for Trump.
sentences.zh: 如果我纯粹是基于我的工会会员身份投票，我会投给特朗普。

sentences.en: But I wouldn't be doing that for me.
sentences.zh: 但我不会为了我自己那样做。

sentences.en: I'd vote for Trump.
sentences.zh: 我会投给特朗普。

sentences.en: You probably.
sentences.zh: 你可能会。

sentences.en: I couldn't.
sentences.zh: 我做不到。

sentences.en: I can't.
sentences.zh: 我不能。

sentences.en: I just can't do it.
sentences.zh: 我就是做不到。

sentences.en: My hand would be shaking.
sentences.zh: 我的手会发抖。

sentences.en: It would be tough.
sentences.zh: 这会很难。

sentences.en: How do you vote for somebody like that?
sentences.zh: 你怎么能投给那样的人？

sentences.en: They're all the same.
sentences.zh: 他们都一样。

sentences.en: You can quote me on this.
sentences.zh: 你可以引用我的话。

sentences.en: Bernie Sanders is the Donald Trump of the left.
sentences.zh: 伯尼·桑德斯就是左翼的唐纳德·特朗普。

sentences.en: That's personally what I think says a lot of ridiculous stuff and promises, all kinds of stuff.
sentences.zh: 这就是我个人的看法，他说了许多荒谬的东西，许下了各种承诺。

sentences.en: He has no idea how he's going to deliver.
sentences.zh: 他根本不知道该如何兑现。

sentences.en: Sort of sounds like the president on the escalator.
sentences.zh: 听起来有点像那位在自动扶梯上的总统。

sentences.en: That's Bernie Sanders.
sentences.zh: 那就是伯尼·桑德斯。

sentences.en: So, you know.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道的。

sentences.en: The only way I go is Biden.
sentences.zh: 我唯一会选的就是拜登。

sentences.en: The only way I go is Biden.
sentences.zh: 我唯一会选的就是拜登。

sentences.en: And I'm a Democrat.
sentences.zh: 而且我是个民主党人。

sentences.en: It makes a lot of sense.
sentences.zh: 这很有道理。

sentences.en: This is the guy from the mayor from South Bend.
sentences.zh: 这就是那位来自南本德的市长。

sentences.en: But I don't think he can get elected.
sentences.zh: 但我不认为他能当选。

sentences.en: But at least when he looks in the camera, he's got the Clinton-Obama look that you want to believe in what he's saying.
sentences.zh: 但至少当他看向镜头时，他有一种克林顿-奥巴马式的神态，让你想要相信他所说的话。

sentences.en: And he's articulate.
sentences.zh: 而且他口才很好。

sentences.en: You know, it scares me.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这让我很害怕。

sentences.en: I love Joe Biden.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢乔·拜登。

sentences.en: But lately, he's not as articulate.
sentences.zh: 但最近，他的口才没那么好了。

sentences.en: What's Trump going to do to him?
sentences.zh: 特朗普会对他做什么？

sentences.en: What's going to happen when they start getting in the debate?
sentences.zh: 当他们开始辩论时会发生什么？

sentences.en: I watch Fox News.
sentences.zh: 我看福克斯新闻。

sentences.en: I watch all the different places.
sentences.zh: 我关注各种不同的渠道。

sentences.en: But obviously, these union leaders are just one side of a political equation.
sentences.zh: 但显然，这些工会领袖只是政治等式的一方。

sentences.en: And on the other side, you have Democrats who are passionate about climate change, who think fracking is terrible for Pennsylvania and for the planet.
sentences.zh: 而在另一方，有热衷于气候变化的民主党人，他们认为水力压裂法对宾夕法尼亚州和地球来说是可怕的。

sentences.en: Shane, do you want to ask?
sentences.zh: 肖恩，你想问吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, we're on the second floor of the library.
sentences.zh: 是的，我们在图书馆的二楼。

sentences.en: And as it happens, we found out that while we were in town, there's a meeting of local environmentalists at the public library.
sentences.zh: 碰巧的是，我们发现当我们在城里时，公共图书馆正在举行一场当地环保人士的会议。

sentences.en: And so we show up.
sentences.zh: 于是我们就去了。

sentences.en: There are bamboo plates, cups, and utensils to be taken, but not to be taken or to be tossed.
sentences.zh: 那里有竹制的盘子、杯子和餐具，可以拿走，但不能带走或乱扔。

sentences.en: Food served, a mix of all plant-based food.
sentences.zh: 提供食物，全是植物性食品的混合。

sentences.en: We've got hummus and tabbouleh.
sentences.zh: 我们有鹰嘴豆泥和塔布勒沙拉。

sentences.en: In the corner is a tabling for vegan spirituality.
sentences.zh: 角落里有一个素食灵性相关的展台。

sentences.en: We've got a couple of different environmental groups looking for sign-ups.
sentences.zh: 我们有几个不同的环保组织在寻求登记。

sentences.en: And a lot of people who seem to already know each other.
sentences.zh: 还有很多看起来已经互相认识的人。

sentences.en: We also are currently smelling, I think, some marijuana in the second floor of this library.
sentences.zh: 我想我们目前在图书馆二楼还闻到了一些大麻的味道。

sentences.en: This might have turned out to be Sage.
sentences.zh: 这可能其实是鼠尾草的味道。

sentences.en: The official name of the event is the Reimagined the Turtle Creek Watershed and Airshed Visioning Session.
sentences.zh: 活动的正式名称是“重构海龟溪流域和空气流域愿景会议”。

sentences.en: As active participants in our interconnected food ecosystem, we each have the power to help heal this plant we call home.
sentences.zh: 作为我们相互关联的食物生态系统中的积极参与者，我们每个人都有力量帮助治愈这个我们称之为家的星球。

sentences.en: A lot of them call themselves fractivists.
sentences.zh: 他们中的许多人称自己为“压裂主义者”。

sentences.en: My name is Alyssa.
sentences.zh: 我叫艾丽莎。

sentences.en: Alyssa?
sentences.zh: 艾丽莎？

sentences.en: The thing they're most focused on is fracking.
sentences.zh: 他们最关注的事情是水力压裂。

sentences.en: Fracking is rape because the chemicals that are carcinogens, the benzene, the toluene, and everything else that's...
sentences.zh: 水力压裂就是强奸，因为那些致癌的化学物质，苯、甲苯，以及其他所有……

sentences.en: Ending and stopping fracking in their part of Pennsylvania.
sentences.zh: 结束并停止在他们宾夕法尼亚州那部分地区进行水力压裂。

sentences.en: They're injecting into our fresh water of our three rivers that we've been cleaning up here for the past 30 years.
sentences.zh: 他们正在把这些东西注入我们三条河流的淡水中，而我们过去30年来一直在这里清理这些河流。

sentences.en: They're taking our resources against our...
sentences.zh: 他们正在掠夺我们的资源，违背我们的……

sentences.en: My name is Jillian Graber.
sentences.zh: 我叫吉莉安·格雷伯。

sentences.en: Are you planning on voting?
sentences.zh: 你打算投票吗？

sentences.en: I am.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I always vote.
sentences.zh: 我总是投票。

sentences.en: If you don't mind my asking, what party do you usually vote for?
sentences.zh: 如果不介意的话，你通常投哪个党派？

sentences.en: Well, it varies.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这不一定。

sentences.en: I don't really consider myself to be part of one party.
sentences.zh: 我并不认为自己属于任何一个党派。

sentences.en: For a while, I was actually...
sentences.zh: 有一段时间，我其实是……

sentences.en: I was a registered Republican.
sentences.zh: 我曾是一名注册共和党人。

sentences.en: And then when Bernie Sanders was running last, I wanted to be able to vote for him.
sentences.zh: 后来当伯尼·桑德斯上次参选时，我希望能投给他。

sentences.en: You know, knowing what he stands for with the environment.
sentences.zh: 你知道，了解他在环境问题上的立场。

sentences.en: So I switched over so I could vote in the primary election for him.
sentences.zh: 所以我转了党籍，这样我就能在初选中投他一票。

sentences.en: You became a Democrat for the first time.
sentences.zh: 你第一次成为了民主党人。

sentences.en: I did.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: For Bernie.
sentences.zh: 为了伯尼。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: But I don't know if I identify with the Democratic Party wholeheartedly.
sentences.zh: 但我不知道我是否全心全意认同民主党。

sentences.en: Mainly because, you know, we have a Democratic governor.
sentences.zh: 主要是因为，你知道，我们有一位民主党州长。

sentences.en: And he's very pro-industry.
sentences.zh: 而且他非常支持工业。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So when it comes to the 2020 contest, who is it that you're favoring?
sentences.zh: 那么说到2020年的竞选，你支持谁？

sentences.en: Are you still a supporter of Bernie Sanders?
sentences.zh: 你还是伯尼·桑德斯的支持者吗？

sentences.en: I still am a supporter of Bernie Sanders.
sentences.zh: 我仍然是伯尼·桑德斯的支持者。

sentences.en: I know that Elizabeth Warren also stands for very similar things.
sentences.zh: 我知道伊丽莎白·沃伦也支持非常相似的主张。

sentences.en: And I would consider potentially voting for her.
sentences.zh: 我会考虑投票给她。

sentences.en: I do not believe under any circumstances that somebody like Joe Biden, who a lot of people feel like maybe the front runner, would be a good,
sentences.zh: 在任何情况下，我都不认为像乔·拜登这样的人——很多人觉得他可能是领跑者——会是一个好的……

sentences.en: would be somebody that would be good for our nation.
sentences.zh: 会是一个对我们国家有益的人。

sentences.en: For the environmentalists at this library, Bernie Sanders and Elizabeth Warren are visionaries who are going to fix the biggest challenges facing our planet.
sentences.zh: 对于图书馆里的这些环保人士来说，伯尼·桑德斯和伊丽莎白·沃伦是能够解决我们星球面临的最大挑战的远见卓识者。

sentences.en: My name is Ellie Gordon.
sentences.zh: 我叫艾莉·戈登。

sentences.en: I heard that you were talking about the political candidates and how they feel about fracking.
sentences.zh: 我听说你们在谈论政治候选人以及他们对水力压裂的看法。

sentences.en: And so I have a lot to say on it.
sentences.zh: 所以我有很多话要说。

sentences.en: I just want to take my feedback.
sentences.zh: 我只是想表达我的反馈。

sentences.en: What is your thoughts?
sentences.zh: 你有什么想法？

sentences.en: Are you going to be just as excited to support a Pete Buttigieg or Joe Biden if they're the nominee?
sentences.zh: 如果皮特·布蒂吉格或乔·拜登成为提名人，你还会同样兴奋地支持他们吗？

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 不会。

sentences.en: And I will not volunteer for their campaign.
sentences.zh: 而且我不会为他们的竞选活动做志愿者。

sentences.en: I will not openly support a candidate who does not take a strong environmental stance in banning fracking.
sentences.zh: 我不会公开支持一个在禁止水力压裂问题上没有坚定环保立场的候选人。

sentences.en: How do you think that will play outside the city if a Bernie Sanders or an Elizabeth Warren is the nominee for the people who work in the industry or work around the industry?
sentences.zh: 你认为如果伯尼·桑德斯或伊丽莎白·沃伦成为提名人，对于那些在行业内或行业周边工作的人来说，这在城外会产生什么影响？

sentences.en: How do you, you know, do you worry about all those people suddenly coming out in droves?
sentences.zh: 你担心那些人会突然成群结队地出来投票吗？

sentences.en: I'm not worried about that because the people who work in the industry and work around it, it's not that many.
sentences.zh: 我不担心，因为在行业内和周边工作的人数并不多。

sentences.en: So they have a loud voice because they have a lot of money, but there aren't that many people.
sentences.zh: 所以他们声音很大是因为他们有很多钱，但人数并不多。

sentences.en: There are, there's the ability for there to be way more jobs in renewable energy.
sentences.zh: 可再生能源领域有创造更多就业机会的潜力。

sentences.en: And so I don't think that's going to be an issue.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为那不会是个问题。

sentences.en: I strongly feel like Bernie or Elizabeth Warren could easily win.
sentences.zh: 我强烈地感觉到伯尼或伊丽莎白·沃伦可以轻松获胜。

sentences.en: And so the argument for the left, for the Sanders and the Warren candidacies, and for others,
sentences.zh: 所以左翼对于桑德斯和沃伦竞选（以及其他人）的论点是，

sentences.en: is that we're going to turn out young people and people who care passionately about the environment in vast numbers by being bold and showing them where we want to go.
sentences.zh: 通过大胆行动并向他们展示我们想要前进的方向，我们将动员大量年轻人和热衷于环境的人出来投票。

sentences.en: And the idea that you're going to win back a big enough share of people from these energy-friendly Democrats who are working in industry, that that's not the play,
sentences.zh: 而那种认为你可以从这些支持能源的民主党人那里赢回足够多选票的想法，那不是制胜策略，

sentences.en: that that's actually, in fact, not the margin play.
sentences.zh: 事实上，那根本不是决定胜负的关键。

sentences.en: The margin play is to mobilize a greater number of younger people who aren't actually already voting.
sentences.zh: 关键在于动员更多尚未投票的年轻人。

sentences.en: Do you think there's just going to be more young people or more people motivated by climate politics not in fracking country?
sentences.zh: 你认为会有更多的年轻人，还是会有更多在非水力压裂地区受气候政治驱动的人？

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对是。

sentences.en: This is an entirely untested proposition.
sentences.zh: 这是一个完全未经检验的命题。

sentences.en: When is the last time the Democratic Party nominated somebody who was talking about building a movement that was outside of the traditional bounds of the mainstream of the party?
sentences.zh: 民主党上一次提名一个谈论建立超越党派主流传统界限的运动的人是什么时候？

sentences.en: Elizabeth Warren's talking about big structural change.
sentences.zh: 伊丽莎白·沃伦谈论的是重大的结构性变革。

sentences.en: Bernie Sanders is talking about a revolution.
sentences.zh: 伯尼·桑德斯谈论的是一场革命。

sentences.en: You can't project what that exactly looks like based on the past because it hasn't happened.
sentences.zh: 你不能根据过去来预测那到底是什么样子，因为这从未发生过。

sentences.en: Can you make that a winning argument?
sentences.zh: 你能让它成为一个制胜的论点吗？

sentences.en: We just don't know.
sentences.zh: 我们只是不知道。

sentences.en: And so you see somebody like a Joe Biden who wants to not ban fracking.
sentences.zh: 所以你看到像乔·拜登这样不想禁止水力压裂的人。

sentences.en: But the interesting thing in talking to these folks at the library, and this was really striking compared to the union leaders, was that at the end of the day,
sentences.zh: 但在图书馆与这些人交谈时，有趣且与工会领袖形成鲜明对比的是，归根结底，

sentences.en: if they don't get their preferred nominee.
sentences.zh: 如果他们没有得到他们首选的提名人。

sentences.en: I would, if he was the only option, I would vote for him and I would feel gross about it.
sentences.zh: 如果他是唯一的选择，我会投给他，但我会觉得很恶心。

sentences.en: But the lesser of two evils.
sentences.zh: 但这是两害相权取其轻。

sentences.en: So let's say the nominee is somebody like Joe Biden, somebody like Pete Buttigieg.
sentences.zh: 所以假设提名人是像乔·拜登或皮特·布蒂吉格这样的人。

sentences.en: I mean, we're at a really weird juxtaposition.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我们正处于一个非常奇怪的并置状态。

sentences.en: You know, there's a lot of there's some I'm sort of between a rock and a hard place on where do I spend my vote?
sentences.zh: 你知道，我有点进退两难，不知道该把票投给谁？

sentences.en: Because on the one hand, Biden says, if you want me to ban fracking, then you better vote for somebody else.
sentences.zh: 因为一方面，拜登说，如果你想让我禁止水力压裂，那你最好投给别人。

sentences.en: And to me,
sentences.zh: 对我来说，

sentences.en: that's like that's a slap in the face and a slap across the faces of every scientist in the world who is screaming about the urgency of addressing climate change at top speed.
sentences.zh: 这就像是对全世界每一位正在呼吁以最快速度应对气候变化的科学家的当众打脸。

sentences.en: So I'm a climate voter and I will cast my vote for the best prospect for climate that I can manage.
sentences.zh: 所以我是一名气候选民，我会尽我所能把票投给对气候最有利的人选。

sentences.en: And if that if that becomes a race between Biden and Trump, I feel Biden is better for climate than Trump by a long shot, by better for a lot of things.
sentences.zh: 如果这变成了拜登和特朗普之间的竞争，我觉得拜登在气候问题上比特朗普好得多，在很多方面都更好。

sentences.en: When it comes to electability and when it comes to the issue of fracking in the state of Pennsylvania, this is what we saw.
sentences.zh: 当谈到当选可能性以及宾夕法尼亚州的水力压裂问题时，这就是我们所看到的。

sentences.en: One group of voters, union leaders, said that if they didn't get their preferred nominee, they might not vote for the Democrat and they might even vote for Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 一群选民（工会领袖）说，如果他们没得到首选的提名人，他们可能不会投给民主党，甚至可能投给唐纳德·特朗普。

sentences.en: And another group of voters, environmentalists, who said that if they didn't get their nominee, they'd still vote for the Democrat.
sentences.zh: 而另一群选民（环保人士）则说，如果他们没得到自己的提名人，他们仍然会投给民主党。

sentences.en: But yeah, nationally, yeah, I'll vote for a Democrat, but that's not the issue.
sentences.zh: 但确实，在全国范围内，我会投给民主党，但这并不是问题的关键。

sentences.en: I would vote for a centrist, but I really don't like that framing because I think it's a little bit defeatiSt.
sentences.zh: 我会投给中间派，但我真的不喜欢那种说法，因为我觉得那有点失败主义。

sentences.en: I would vote for anybody that was running against Trump.
sentences.zh: 我会投给任何与特朗普竞选的人。

sentences.en: I would even vote for Mike Pence running against Trump.
sentences.zh: 我甚至会投给迈克·彭斯来对抗特朗普。

sentences.en: I think Trump is evil and dangerous and we need to replace him with almost anybody who's breathing.
sentences.zh: 我认为特朗普是邪恶且危险的，我们需要用几乎任何一个有呼吸的人来取代他。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
